description: A React component named Modal that implements a flexible, accessible modal dialog with overlay, customizable positioning, and optional footer and header offset. It handles backdrop clicks and ESC key to close, uses createPortal for rendering outside the DOM hierarchy, and includes embedded styles for appearance and accessibility.

methods.name: Modal
methods.description: React functional component that renders a modal dialog with customizable props for position, size, and content, including internal effects for keyboard handling and portal rendering.
